collections.name: users
collections.description: Stores user profiles including their role, details, and networking preferences.

access.read: Authenticated users can read any profile.
access.create: Authenticated users can create their own profile.
access.update: Users can only update their own profile.

collections.name: posts
collections.description: Stores social posts made by users.

access.read: Authenticated users can read all posts.
access.create: Authenticated users can create posts with their own authorId.
access.update: Users can update likes, or their own posts.
access.delete: Users can delete their own posts.

fields.name: participants
fields.description: Array of user UIDs involved in the chat

fields.name: lastMessage
fields.description: Preview of the last message sent

access.read: Authenticated users who are in the participants array can read.
access.create: Authenticated users can create chats if they are in the participants array.
access.update: Participants can update the chat (e.g. lastMessage).

collections.name: messages
collections.description: Stores individual messages within a chat.

access.read: Authenticated users who are participants in the parent chat can read.
access.create: Authenticated users who are participants in the parent chat can create messages.
